name: Network Security Event – Containment
description:
## 🎯 Purpose
Halt active threats and prevent lateral movement or data exfiltration.

---

## 📌 Objectives
1. Perimeter Hardening (FW/Proxy blocks).
2. Host Segregation.
3. Forensic Preservation (Memory/PCAP).

tasks.title: Task 1: Perimeter & Edge Blocking
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Sever communication with the Malicious Actor.
### 📌 Actions
* Apply 'Deny' rules for the source IP on Firewall/IPS.
* Blacklist malicious domain/URI at the Web Proxy.
### ✅ Deliverables
* Confirmation of perimeter block.

tasks.title: Task 2: Affected Host Isolation
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Prevent lateral movement.
### 📌 Actions
* Isolate host via VLAN steering or EDR isolation.
* For critical assets, apply host-based FW 'Restrictive Mode'.
### ✅ Deliverables
* Isolation status of internal assets.

tasks.title: Task 3: Service & Port Remediation
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Remove the specific entry point.
### 📌 Actions
* Shutdown unauthorized services or close identified ports.
* Disable compromised local or API accounts.
### ✅ Deliverables
* Service remediation report.

tasks.title: Task 4: Forensic Collection & Preservation
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Secure evidence for root cause analysis.
### 📌 Actions
* Trigger memory dump of affected host(s).
* Export security logs and Zeek flow data.
* **Collect PCAP for the affected timeframe (if available).**
### ✅ Deliverables
* Evidence inventory and links in TheHive.
